checked_claims.note: For the smooth dimension-21 DM stack, H^{BM}_{16} is H^{26}(21). Twisting weight 26 by (21) gives weight -16, and Q(-13)(21)=Q(8). The degrees and every Tate twist match the exact rational-coefficient target.
The lowest-weight piece W_26 H^26 is the image from the smooth proper compactification and is pure of weight 26. This establishes purity of weight, not Hodge-Tate type.

The Leray sequence has only q=0,1. Its q=0 term in total degree 26 vanishes, and the possible d2 maps adjacent to E2^{25,1} have zero targets or sources, so the asserted degree-26 mixed-Hodge-structure identification follows.

Strictness of the weight filtration and the weight floor for Q(-1) give the stated W_26 surjection and kernel subquotient. This route only reduces the problem to the unproved local-system group W_26 H^25(M_{6,5};H).

The supplied SRC-0002 excerpt records only a range n<=c(g) and a fragment referring to Lemma 4.3; it does not itself supply c(6)>=5 or the complete CKgP theorem used here. Even if accepted for M_{6,5}, it controls constant coefficients only and does not discharge the H-coefficient reduction.

With the packet's gamma^*O(-f) convention, deg W_5=16, deg L=6, and the Serre-dual obstruction degrees are 0 for f=5 and -4 for f=4. On the balanced locus, the degree-zero obstruction is nonzero exactly when O_C(Gamma) is isomorphic to L.

The count 15+2=17 does not establish that the incidence map is generically finite, that its image is a pure codimension-4 component, or that stack stabilizers do not change the asserted description. The hyperelliptic, trigonal, plane-quintic, unbalanced, and nonreduced strata are named but not individually constructed or dimension-bounded; no exhaustive stable-pair or closure analysis is supplied.

The numerical codimension-4 purity shift H_Z^26 <- H^18(Z)(-4) is correct when purity applies, but the Tate premise is not proved. A finite morphism to an open of M_{0,18} does not make the source mixed Tate: its finite pushforward can contain nontrivial local systems. Likewise, rational S_6 averaging identifies invariant summands only after Tate purity of the covering space has been established; it does not establish that purity. Contributions and differentials from the omitted lower strata remain uncontrolled.

This is the strongest load-bearing gap. No actual presentation of U, sequence of maps, or applicable preservation theorem is supplied. SRC-0002 concerns the stated M_{g,n} range and does not establish CKgP for this CE-surjective open. Consequently Lemma 4.3 cannot yet be applied to W_26 H^26(U).

The final localization argument depends on CLM-0007 through CLM-0009. Conditional on pure Q(-13) support and open terms, strictness and semisimplicity would give an actual rational Hodge-structure isomorphism, not merely a semisimplification; those premises are not established.

adjudication.notes: This is a proof gap, not evidence that the exact target contains a non-Tate summand.

strongest_attack: CLM-0009 is an undischarged load-bearing assertion: the attempt never constructs the claimed CKgP presentation of the CE-surjective open U or cites a theorem covering that open. Without Tate purity of W_26 H^26(U), localization cannot prove the exact theorem. Independently, CLM-0008 uses the invalid implication that a finite cover of a mixed-Tate configuration space is itself mixed Tate. These defects make the proof incomplete but do not exhibit a surviving non-Tate summand and therefore do not refute the theorem.
theorem_statement: The exact group W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q), equivalently W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)(21), is a direct sum of Q(8); a disproof must exhibit a surviving non-Tate summand in this exact group.
